items.name: utils

items.description: A Tailwind-aware class name utility that resolves conflicting utilities.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A tactile neumorphic button with raised and pressed states.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A composable raised, flat, or inset neumorphic surface.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: An inset neumorphic text input with accessible focus and error states.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact neumorphic status label.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A softly inset loading placeholder.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: An accessible tooltip with delayed open, Escape dismiss, and portal positioning.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A keyboard-accessible disclosure group with inset open states.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A raised status message with default, success, and destructive variants.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A resilient profile image with fallback, status badge, and group support.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Wrapping path navigation; place each separator inside its destination item to keep the pair together.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A controlled or uncontrolled checkbox with indeterminate support.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: An accessible modal surface with focus trapping and dismiss controls.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A complete keyboard-accessible menu with checkbox, radio, and submenu items.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: One inset input surface with inline addons; multiline controls span the surface above their actions.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible form label with disabled-state styling.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Responsive pagination that preserves navigation targets and compacts labels at narrow container widths.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: An accessible inset progress track with a primary fill.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A controlled or uncontrolled radio group with horizontal and vertical layouts.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A compact scrollable surface with themed native scrollbars.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A native select control styled as an inset neumorphic field.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A horizontal or vertical divider for grouping related content.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A tactile range control with shadcn-compatible array value callbacks.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A controlled or uncontrolled switch with clear pressed depth.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table with native horizontal scrolling and boundary-aware edge cues.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Keyboard-accessible tabs with raised active controls and inset lists.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A resizable inset text area with focus and validation states.

items.name: style-air
items.title: Air
items.description: The default cool blue Neumorphism UI style with balanced depth and soft controls.
